                COMMENTS ON THE PETITION FOR LATE INTERVENTION


       Entergy Louisiana,       LLC.     (“ELL”     or            the   “Company") through undersigned counsel,

respectfully submits these       Comments      on   the Petition for Late Intervention and          Request for

Inclusion on the Service List (“Petition”) filed by the Gulf States Energy Industry Association


(“GSREIA") in response to the Notice of Opportunity to Comment (“Notice”) issued by the

Tribunal on June 25, 2026.


       GSREIA’s Petition was filed on June 18, 2026 and seeks, among other things, that GSREIA


be permitted to intervene in the captioned docket well after the deadline for interventions.             Based


upon GSREIA‘s representation that it “does not seek to reopen previously completed procedural


matters and accepts the record as it    presently exists," the Company has no objection to the granting

of GSREIA’s request to intervene out of time.


       However, the Company notes that although the Petition was filed on June 18, 2026 and


includes   a   ceitificate of service   certifying that the Petition “has been served upon all parties

appearing on the Official Service List in accordance with" the Commission’s Rules of Practice

and Procedure (the “Rules”), undersigned counsel for ELL—who is on the Official Service List—


has received no such service from GSREIA. In fact, the first notice undersigned counsel received


of the filing of the Petition was through the Tribunal’s Notice, a full week after the Petition was
 ﬁled with the Commission.    Accordingly, the Company respectfully requests that in the event the

Tribunal permits GSREIA’s untimely intervention that it does so contingent upon GSREIA actual


compliance with the Commission’s Rules, including Rule 7(C) requiring service of pleadings on

all parties, for the remainder of the proceeding.




                                                    Respectfully submitted,
